request.statement:
Define `route_release_packets(forge, project, releases, tags, tag_pattern, requests)`.

A forge gateway routes one version packet per request.

If `forge["kind"]` is `"public"`, its web address is `https://github.com`. If it is `"enterprise"`, `forge["api_base"]` must end exactly in `/api/v3`; removing that suffix gives a nonempty web address. Otherwise raise `ValueError`.

`project` is an `owner/name` string using ASCII letters, digits, `-`, `_`, `.`, and `/`. `releases` contains `{ "tag": str, "timestamp": str }`; timestamps are fixed-width UTC ISO-8601 strings ordered chronologically by lexicographic comparison. `tags` is a list of strings. Tags are nonempty ASCII strings.

If `releases` is nonempty, only releases are used, even if filtering removes all of them. Otherwise tags are used with timestamp `None`.

If `tag_pattern` is not `None`, discard advertisements whose original tag is not a full match for that valid Python regular expression. Normalize a surviving tag by removing one leading lowercase `v` exactly when followed by an ASCII digit.

Each request is `{ "query": str, "include_prerelease": bool, "as_of": str or None }`. Queries are nonempty ASCII strings. For releases, an advertisement is eligible when `as_of` is `None` or its timestamp is at most `as_of`. For fallback tags, `as_of` has no effect. Thus different requests may observe different release histories.

For each request, merge eligible advertisements with the same normalized version. For releases retain the newest timestamp; ties retain the lexicographically smaller original tag, then the earlier input position. For tags retain the lexicographically smaller tag, then input position.

A numeric-leading version has a maximal initial core of one to eight dot-separated ASCII decimal integers; the remainder is its suffix. It is a prerelease exactly when the suffix starts with `-`. Other versions are non-prerelease labels.

Priority is:
1. numeric-leading versions before labels;
2. numeric cores componentwise descending after padding to eight components with zeros;
3. for equal cores, non-prereleases before prereleases, then suffix, normalized version, and original tag lexicographically ascending;
4. labels by normalized version, then original tag ascending.

`"latest"` selects the highest-priority permitted merged advertisement. Any other query is normalized like a tag and selects the highest-priority permitted version starting with it. Prereleases are permitted only when `include_prerelease` is true. Return `None` if none qualifies.

A packet is `{ "version", "tag", "timestamp", "url", "source" }`. Percent-encode the tag as one URL path component. Release URLs are `WEB/project/releases/tag/TAG`; tag URLs are `WEB/project/tree/TAG`. Return packets in request order.

There are at most 200,000 advertisements and requests each; total tag and query length is at most 2,000,000. Use only the standard library, without I/O, network, filesystem access, mutable global state, or nondeterminism.
